description: action `build` (default): build the iOS app under projectDir for the simulator (auto-detects container and scheme) and install it, returning the bundle id — use before tapp_explore/tapp_look when the app is not installed; `install`: build a given project/workspace + scheme and install it; `simulators`: list available simulators; `boot`: boot one by udid or name.

install.description: build: install on the booted simulator afterwards

projectDir.description: build: dir to search for the .xcworkspace/.xcodeproj (default cwd)

name: tapp_build
title: iOS simulator: build, install, boot
